summary: Verified the Sound → Fire migration for the legacy 'Calling in The City' post (canonical post d7e3d36d-ce28-49c5-96b5-4c60d2445174, track e8e5aa8b39454b23b044f314411d3bb4, owner @auditcheckreal). Backend: 4/4 API tests pass — no raw is_sound_track rows in the sound feed, exactly one canonical post for Calling in The City with fire_total>=1, GET /api/fire/post/{id} returns my_fire=1 for stealth, POST /api/fire/react cycles 1→3→1 successfully with wallet pool charge on boost and refund on reduce. Frontend: On /feed with Sounds filter — the post renders ONCE, shows FireButton (feed-fire-<postid>-btn / -total / -boost-open) with total=1 and NO feed-like-* testids on that card. Fire picker (my_fire>0) opens on tap, quick buttons and slider work, boosted to 3× (Send 3× 🔥) → total updated to 3 and my_multiplier '×3' immediately, persisted after reload. State restored back to 1× via API to leave the verification artifact clean. /sounds page uses FireButton on every track card (sounds-fire-*) and has ZERO sounds-like-* testids anywhere, confirming the Sound tracks no longer show the old heart control. Profile /profile/auditcheckreal loads but does not list individual sound tracks (skipped per guidance). Non-sound posts on /feed still show FireButton for public posts and feed-like-* for friends-only posts (regression clean).

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify PostPopup / post-popup-fire testid — feed sound cards ([data-testid="feed-sound-<postId>"]) contain no clickable element that opens a PostPopup, and direct navigation to /post/<id> redirects back to /feed (no such route). Only the -audio child testid exists inside the card. If PostPopup should be reachable from a Sound feed card, add an open-detail affordance (clickable title/thumbnail or a dedicated /post/:id route) so that post-popup-fire renders as required by the review criterion.

integration_issues.flow: Sounds page discovery of Calling in The City
integration_issues.issue: On /sounds (Music tab, Top 100, All genres, radius Any), the legacy migrated track 'Calling in The City' does NOT appear in Featured / Made for You / Top 100 lists, and searching the title yields 'No Music tracks here yet'. The reviewer requirement 'Sounds page — Calling in The City track card must render FireButton' cannot be positively verified because the track isn't surfaced. All OTHER tracks that DO appear on /sounds render sounds-fire-* correctly and there are ZERO sounds-like-* testids on the page, so the FireButton wiring itself is verified — but discovery/indexing of the legacy track into /sounds charts seems missing (likely genre/mood metadata or chart-eligibility filter excluding it).

action_items: Add a way to open PostPopup for a Sound feed card (either make the sound card body clickable to open PostPopup, or expose a /post/:id route). Currently the review criterion 'PostPopup must show FireButton (post-popup-fire...)' cannot be verified because no post-popup-* testids ever appear from the Calling in The City card.

Investigate why the migrated legacy sound 'Calling in The City' does not appear on /sounds (Featured/Made-for-You/Top 100 nor via title search). Ensure the canonical sound backfill also populates whatever chart/genre index /sounds queries, or explicitly include is_canonical_sound tracks in the Sounds page listings.
critical_code_review_comments: Feed cards for sounds have no clickable affordance to reach PostPopup — the card [data-testid=feed-sound-<postId>] only wraps the audio player and metadata; UX-wise, consumers can never see the full-post view (comments, share, boost) for a sound post via popup.

/sounds discovery pipeline appears independent of the sound_posts backfill: newly canonicalized legacy tracks are visible in /feed?media_type=sound but not in the /sounds Music charts. Consider unifying the data source or explicitly indexing canonical sound posts into the Sounds page query.

401 errors flood the browser console on every page load (Failed to load resource: 401). Even authenticated pages emit dozens of 401s — investigate service worker / preflight auth on optional endpoints; noisy console makes real errors harder to spot.
seed_data_creation: None. Boosted Calling in The City to 3× via frontend, then restored to 1× via /api/fire/react to leave the verification artifact intact (stealth: my_fire=1, fire_total=1 confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fire+sound migration is solid — test_sound_fire_migration.py (7/7) and test_sound_fire_frontend_review.py (4/4) both pass. Two frontend gaps remain: (1) no PostPopup opener from sound feed card / no /post/:id route so post-popup-fire cannot be exercised; (2) 'Calling in The City' isn't listed on /sounds page charts or via search though its canonical post exists. Restored stealth's fire on the target post back to 1×.
rca of the issue: Both frontend gaps stem from wiring omissions rather than logic bugs. PostPopup: sound feed cards were converted from 'audio+minimal metadata' to include a FireButton, but no onClick handler / <Link> was added to open the full post view. Sounds page: /sounds queries the tracks charts pipeline, which is populated at upload time; the migration script backfilled canonical posts but did not re-emit chart entries for legacy tracks.
